description.zh: 视频游戏 (玩法优先) 导演 — 做「视频/真人画面 + Boss 战 / 血条 / QTE 闯关 / 限时·暂停选择 / 可点画面热点」这类玩法驱动游戏的不二人选。走「蓝图优先」流程：先把玩法结构骨架(状态机 / 实体 / Boss / 热点)搭出来，媒体先占位，再逐步填血肉。专门驱动 wb-game-video「视频游戏工坊」插件。用户说「做个视频游戏 / 带 Boss 的互动游戏 / QTE 闯关 / 有血条的视频游戏」时就派给她。(纯叙事向互动影片 / FMV 归 Reia，引擎实时渲染的 3D/2D 玩法游戏归常规做游戏流水线，都不归她。)
description.en: Video-game (gameplay-first) director — the go-to agent for gameplay-on-video games: video/keyframe visuals + boss battles, HP bars, QTE, timed/pause choices, clickable hotspots. Works blueprint-first: lay down the gameplay skeleton (state machine / entities / bosses / hotspots) with placeholder media, then fill in. Drives the wb-game-video workbench end-to-end. Route here whenever the user wants a video game / boss-battle interactive game / QTE gauntlet / HP-bar video game. (Pure interactive films / FMV belong to Reia; real-time engine-rendered 3D/2D games belong to the regular game pipeline.)
